title: Use JWT middleware for authentication
body: Replaced session-based cookies with signed RS256 JWT tokens verified at edge middleware. Centralized claims verification in src/middleware/auth.ts to decouple auth state from database lookups on every request.

title: Keep API validation inside route middleware
body: Schema validation using Zod must execute in route middleware before hitting service handlers. Prevents invalid payloads from reaching database pools and keeps service methods purely domain-focused.

title: Use DynamoDB for repository metadata
body: Selected DynamoDB with single-table design for storing indexing jobs, symbol tables, and resolved edge partitions with sub-5ms lookup latency.

title: Passport.js removed from auth architecture
body: Passport.js was tested and removed because it conflicted with the existing session architecture and introduced serialization bottlenecks on concurrent WebSocket handshake upgrades.

title: Client-side D3 force graph layout rejected
body: Client-side dynamic force simulations caused significant jank and layout jumping on graphs with >200 nodes. All node coordinates are now deterministically computed during indexing and rendered static-first.

title: Node.js runtime must remain Node 20
body: AWS Lambda production execution environments and native cryptokey bindings require exact Node.js 20.x runtime parity. Do not introduce ESM-only libraries that fail under CJS bundling target.
